diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project to var.shared_vpc_service_config.host_project, but has no ordering relationship with google_project_service.project_services. Attaching a service project requires the Compute Engine API (and any other requested services) to already be enabled in the service project; if the API activation in project_services is still in flight, the attachment fails or the project is attached before it is usable. Every other resource in shared-vpc.tf (shared_vpc_host, service_projects, and the shared_vpc_host_robots IAM members) guards on project_services — this resource should too, since its only implicit dependency is var.shared_vpc_service_config.
